title: Mobility vs Deliberation Support — Movement Speed or More Damage?
summary: Mobility and Deliberation are two support gems that change how movement-casting skills feel. Mobility reduces the movement-speed penalty of skills you can use while moving; Deliberation adds More Damage but increases the movement penalty. This guide compares them, lists which skills can socket each, explains the damage scope, and gives mapping versus bossing decisions.
description: Mobility vs Deliberation support guide: which skills can be used while moving, the movement penalty field, Mobility's less-movement-penalty, Deliberation's More Damage and extra penalty, whether both can be socketed, valid skill matrix, damage scope including DoT and secondary, mapping versus bossing decisions, controller notes, skill examples and troubleshooting.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial
imageAlt: Mobility and Deliberation support gems comparison icon

sections.title: Quick Answer
paragraphs: Mobility reduces the movement-speed penalty of skills you can cast while moving — it does not increase your normal walk speed, it just makes moving-cast skills less sluggish.
Deliberation adds a chunk of More Damage but increases the movement penalty, so you trade clear smoothness for raw damage.
They occupy the same support category on a skill, so you usually socket one or the other, not both, on a given skill.

supports.label: Mobility
notes: Reduces the movement-speed penalty of skills usable while moving.
Does not raise base move speed; it only softens the penalty.
Best when you want to keep casting while kiting.

supports.label: Deliberation
notes: Adds More Damage to the supported skill.
Increases the movement penalty, making moving-cast clumsier.
Best when you can stand and output, or when the damage outweighs the penalty.

sections.title: Requirements
paragraphs: Both are support gems slotted into a skill that supports the relevant skill type. They only matter for skills that have a movement-speed penalty while used on the move.

sections.title: Movement-Casting Tradeoff
paragraphs: Some skills let you act while moving but apply a movement-speed penalty shown on the skill itself. Mobility's 'less movement speed penalty' reduces that penalty; it is not a generic speed buff.
Deliberation's More Damage is attractive, but its extra penalty means you move slower while using the skill — which can cost you output windows if you have to dodge.
Crossbow reload is a separate action and is not the same as using a movement-cast skill; the penalty only applies to skills that explicitly allow moving use.
bullets: Penalty is on the skill, not your walk speed.
Mobility softens it; Deliberation worsens it for damage.
Reload is a different action from moving-cast.

sections.title: Damage Scope
paragraphs: Deliberation's More Damage applies to the skill's hit damage. Whether it affects Damage over Time, explosions or secondary damage depends on how the skill's damage is structured.
A tooltip damage increase does not always mean higher practical DPS if the movement penalty forces you to stop attacking to dodge — the lost uptime can outweigh the raw multiplier.
Test the skill on a dummy: compare tooltip damage against real clear and boss time with each support.
bullets: More Damage hits the skill's hit damage.
DoT, explosions, secondary may not all scale.
Tooltip gain can be lost to downtime.

sections.title: Mapping Decision
paragraphs: In open maps, Mobility is usually better: you keep moving and clearing, and the smoother movement prevents deaths more than a damage multiplier helps.
If a map lets you stand and delete packs, Deliberation's damage is fine, but most mapping favours mobility.
bullets: Open maps: Mobility for safety and speed.
Stand-and-clear maps: Deliberation acceptable.
HC or low defense: Mobility.

sections.title: Bossing Decision
paragraphs: Against a boss where you can stand and output, Deliberation's More Damage pays off. If the boss forces constant dodging, Mobility keeps your uptime.
High-frequency-dodge bosses favour Mobility; stationary DPS checks favour Deliberation.
bullets: Stationary DPS: Deliberation.
Constant dodge: Mobility.
Match the support to the fight.

sections.title: Controller and Input Notes
paragraphs: On controller or with auto-aim, the value of moving while casting changes: if you naturally kite, Mobility helps; if you tend to stand and aim, Deliberation's damage is easier to use.
Keyboard and mouse players who kite manually get more from Mobility's smoothness.
bullets: Controller auto-aim: Deliberation often fine.
Manual kite (KBM): Mobility smoother.
Personal playstyle drives the choice.

sections.title: Skill Examples
paragraphs: Spark and Ice Shot are low-penalty skills where Mobility barely changes feel but Deliberation adds real damage if you stand. Galvanic Shards and Shockburst Rounds have more penalty, so Mobility matters more for uptime.
Pick the support per skill rather than globally — one skill can run Mobility while another runs Deliberation.
bullets: Spark / Ice Shot: either works.
Galvanic / Shockburst: Mobility for uptime.
Mix per skill.

sections.title: Build Usage
paragraphs: Use Mobility on your main clear skill for map safety, and consider Deliberation on a single-target skill you cast while standing during boss downtime.
The choice is per-socket, so tune each skill to its role.
bullets: Clear skill: Mobility.
Boss single-target: Deliberation if standing.
Per-socket tuning.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: If a skill cannot socket one of them, the skill's category or moving-use flag excludes it. If tooltip damage rises but real DPS falls, the movement penalty is costing uptime — switch to Mobility.
bullets: Cannot socket: skill category excludes it.
DPS fell with Deliberation: penalty cost uptime.
No speed gain from Mobility: it only cuts penalty.
Both not socketing: same support category.
Reload feels slow: separate from moving-cast.

sections.title: Community Evidence
paragraphs: Players generally run Mobility on clear skills and Deliberation only when a build stands to output, noting that the penalty often hurts more than the damage helps in real fights.
The most common question is whether Mobility raises walk speed — it does not.
bullets: Mobility for clear, Deliberation when standing.
Mobility is not a walk-speed buff.
